mechanism: Lock a fast carrier and its camera to one continuous constrained route. Escalate by reducing clearance from different sides while preserving forward direction and recurring route geometry. Make one final tunnel or aperture the tightest compression, then cross it exactly once into a materially wider environment where near obstacles disappear and the camera finally slows enough to prove the release.

invariants.rule: Establish one fast carrier, forward route and coupled camera before the first hard constriction.
invariants.ablation_failure: A late carrier reveal makes clearance impossible to judge.

invariants.rule: Reduce usable clearance progressively with side, overhead and route obstacles.
invariants.purpose: Builds pressure through geometry rather than random cuts.

invariants.rule: Keep carrier and camera on the same continuous direction through each opening.
invariants.ablation_failure: Axis resets turn the sequence into disconnected action shots.

invariants.rule: Use one final tunnel or aperture as the narrowest visible compression.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several equivalent exits dilute the peak.

invariants.rule: Cross once into an obstacle-free large environment and let the camera widen or slow.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuing dense hazards after the exit cancels the release.

instantiations.concept: An original amber survey submersible races through a flooded coral maintenance trench. Rock ribs, hanging kelp and rotating valve hoops progressively reduce clearance; one final intake tube is the narrowest point, then the craft exits into a vast bioluminescent basin and slows above open water.
